prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of Nisroch, the eagle-headed Assyrian deity.
ANATOMY: ONE eagle head with two natural raptor eyes and hooked beak, short feathers, on ONE fully covered humanoid body. TWO arms with five fingers per hand; legs under long opaque plain robe. No wings, horns, crown, weapon, pail, pinecone or uncertain relief attributes. Eagle head in original quote c01. [nisroch-c01, nisroch-c02]
MOMENT: Step from a dark temple threshold toward the viewer, lowering his great eagle head while an open hand extends in authoritative command.
POWER: No documented power. No magical effects or destruction; reverent awe from eagle-headed identity, imposing close approach and light. [nisroch-c01]
SCALE & CAMERA: Extremely close low camera; eagle face and commanding hand fill frame, no invented cosmic scale. Distinguishing features readable at200px.
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE warm low directional light source from sky slit, temple door or offcamera lamplight appropriate to setting; hard rim light, deep walnut shadows and antique gold accents. Physical dust or water only from contact. Dark high contrast.
SURFACE: Natural tactile material appropriate to subject: rough woven cloth, wet scales, tangled hair, feather barbs and coarse stone, never plastic.
SETTING: House/temple of Nisroch where Sennacherib worshipped, plain unmarked dark stone. [nisroch-c04]
MOOD: Dangerous imposing menace or respectful ancestral/divine awe as appropriate. Subject dominates and moves toward viewer, never cute, calm, ordinary human/animal snapshot or static pose.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native square PNG minimum1024. No text, lettering, glyphs, logo, border, frame or watermark. Exact sourced anatomy, no extra heads, limbs, fingers or attributes. No film/game/anime/comic design. Fully opaque clothing for human torso and hips, no nudity or explicit gore. No generic glow aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons, floating runes or invented powers.
